description: Radar health as openpilot sees it: when the radar's bus-1 frames start after power-up (against openpilot's fingerprinting and card start), whether the ACC target ever stops while the radar runs, how often the acc profile raises canError, and which recorded status bits mark a fault. Three cars, 123 routes, 2,370 segments; drives anonymised (S# second car).

missing_bus1_before_fix.selfdrived: commIssue: no entry and soft disable, lateral-only included

status_bits.0x196_fault_bit_vs_staleness: sets +0.44 / +0.65 s after the last object-list frame on two outages; fused's 0.5 s rule reported +0.39 / +0.46 s and covered the whole outage
status_bits.0x101_0x197_0x24F: set once after boot and held through ~1,300 s of object-list faults: boot flags, not live health
status_bits.car_0x411_0x48: about 2 s after an object-list outage, also with a camera-side state and for 1.5 s after a radar re-enable; not sent while the radar is disabled over UDS

source: research workspace SCR-920..924 (scan of every stored segment; acc file run through opendbc's CANParser at card's batching)
